text:
maya: Heads up — we just saw a small but persistent mismatch between charge reports and trace-derived cost for compacted envelopes. Likely post-enrich attributes getting dropped during compaction.
tony: ugh. where in the pipeline? compactification stage before the late-enrich join?
elena: yes, compactor runs at ingress and strips non-essential attrs. The late-enrich adds billing.owner and billing.sku after compaction sometimes.
maya: can we add a provenance tag that survives compaction? e.g., _src_attrs: [billing.*] so compactor preserves those keys.
sam: that would increase envelope size. We're trying to keep the compacted envelope small to hit cold-path quotas.
elena: true — tradeoff. Alternative: emit a lightweight sidecar record mapping compact_id -> late_attrs, persisted for N minutes for stitching.
ton: sidecar approach sounds reasonable but we need TTL/garbage collection and cross-shard lookup considerations.
maya: agreed. We should also think about sampling interactions: if the request is sampled out before late-enrich, we lose cost attribution entirely.
sam: proposal: 1) add provenance bitset in compactor for a few critical keys (billing.* only), encoded as a tiny integer. 2) emit sidecar for full late attrs but only for heavy customers.
elena: bitset approach nice — small overhead. need mapping from key->bit index in config.
ton: how do rollouts work? we need backward compat for older compactors. maybe compactor accepts optional schema v2 flag and falls back.
maya: rollout plan: start with bitset flag off; enable for 10% of edge nodes; monitor mismatch delta for those customers. ops-bot: deploy scheduled: compactor-v2 -> canary -> 2026-04-02 18:00 UTC
sam: question about analytics: how will billing pipeline consume sidecars? we can fold sidecar join into the stitcher with join key compact_id and time window 5m. If missing, fallback to approximate attribution via route hints.
elena: add guardrail: if sidecar not found, emit a soft-metric (cost.attribution.missed) so downstream teams can alert.
ton: edge case: model-routing fallback could change billing.sku between request and enrichment. We should record both pre-enrich and post-enrich sku when present.
maya: yes record both. bitset only indicates presence; sidecar has full before/after diffs.
sam: I'll sketch protos:```
message CompactMeta {
  int64 compact_id = 1;
  uint32 billing_bitset = 2; // bitmap for billing.* presence
  int64 ts_ms = 3;
}
message LateAttrsSidecar {
  int64 compact_id = 1;
  map<string,string> attrs = 2;
}
```
elena: proto looks fine. For GC: store sidecars in TTL bucketed s3 for 10 minutes and a pika-index for fast lookup (redis) for 2 minutes.
ton: encryption/PII check: make sure attrs map only contains non-PII fields. Add schema whitelist.
maya: good call. Add an ingest-time validator that filters/strips disallowed keys.
sam: ops ask: what's perf overhead? bitset adds 4 bytes per envelope, sidecar adds a write to s3/redis — should be within budget if we route sidecars async.
maya: final ask: elena + sam to PR compactor changes and a short rollout playbook. I'll own the instrumentation and dashboard to track cost drift.
elena: will do. I'll open PR and include migration compatibility tests.
sam: opening infra task for sidecar storage and GC.
ton: ping me on the canary window, I'll watch for routing-induced sku flips.
ops-bot: note: incident channel alerted on cost.attribution.missed > 5/min for prod.
maya: thanks all — followups in the PR and I'll post the dashboard link when live.
